blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Which of these are terms of three x squared minus five x plus seven? Choose all that apply.
Three x squared. It is the first piece of the expression, so it is a term.
Negative five x. The minus sign travels with the term after it, so this is a term.
Five x. This leaves out the minus sign. The term is negative five x. Not a term of this expression.
Seven. It is the last piece, added at the end. A term with no variable is still a term.
x squared. This is only part of three x squared. It is a factor inside the first term, not a term by itself.
Three of them are terms: three x squared, negative five x, and seven. Terms are the pieces separated by plus and minus signs, and each keeps its sign.
